# Keep one-shot property listeners tied to the header and property

FolderPropertyChangeListener resolves only when both the header and property match, then removes itself from the mail session. Its seen method returns the stored promise. The caller creates it only for a nonempty delta. There is no timeout or cancellation path in the inspected class; mutation errors or an absent expected event remain a static cleanup concern, not a reproduced leak. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Folder property listener identity and limits.
